_comment: Per-SID songlength overrides applied after HVSC ingest in build_sid_db.py. Keyed by md5(file). Use when HVSC's Songlengths.md5 has anomalously short or otherwise wrong durations and we have a principled reason to correct them. The override survives HVSC re-fetches; the corresponding line in HVSC's Songlengths.md5 is also edited in place but that file is gitignored.
